name: HZ_IMP_BATCH_SUMMARY
description: The HZ_IMP_BATCH_SUMMARY table stores information about import batches which contain a set of records to be imported from the interface tables into the TCA Registry. The table includes information on the processes that the user chooses to perform on the import batch, such as import preview. The table also stores information about batches of records purged from the interface table.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Interface batch identifier

columns.name: BATCH_NAME
columns.description: Batch name

columns.name: ORIGINAL_SYSTEM
columns.description: Original source system for the batch data

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Batch description

columns.name: EST_NO_OF_RECORDS
columns.description: Estimated number of records in the batch as entered by the user

columns.name: LOAD_TYPE
columns.description: Type of load.CSV for CSV file load, DNB for D&B batch load, or SQL load, with value entered by the user.

columns.name: ERROR_LIMIT
columns.description: User-defined error limit, after which the batch will fail

columns.name: VALIDATE_FLEXFIELD_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether flexfields should be validated during import or not

columns.name: WHAT_IF_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether or not the user wants to stop the process before the data is loaded into TCA and evaluate the results

columns.name: BATCH_STATUS
columns.description: Overall status of the batch. Active, Purged, or Rejected

columns.name: CSV_STATUS
columns.description: Status for the CSV load concurrent program

columns.name: CSV_LOAD_ID
columns.description: CSV File Load Identifier. Foreign Key to IMC_CSV_LOAD_SUMMARY

columns.name: PURGE_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the batch was purged

columns.name: PURGED_BY_USER_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the user who purged the batch

columns.name: PROCESSED_STEP
columns.description: Process completed

columns.name: IN_PROCESS_STEP
columns.description: Process in progress

columns.name: TO_PROCESS_STEP
columns.description: Process to start

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_APP_NAME
columns.description: Concurrent Program who column - Identifies the Application name spawning the Concurrent Request. FK to fnd_global.prog_appl_name.

columns.name: PROGRAM_NAME
columns.description:
Concurrent Program who column - Identifies the concurrent program. 
FK to fnd_global.conc_program_name.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: HWM_PROCESS_CODE
columns.description: Stores the high water mark process so import will know  validation should be re-run or not.

columns.name: SYSTASK_ID
columns.description: System Task Identifier

columns.name: STATISTIC_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Statistic Group Id for the batch

columns.name: BATCH_OBJECT
columns.description: Object type of the batch. Customer and Consumer, Employee Resource, Partner, Custom Party, Competitor or Reference

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Internal use column. Store the file import object type code

columns.name: EVENT_TYPE
columns.description: This column is to store the event_type value getting from the payload.

columns.name: EXECUTION_CONTEXT
columns.description: This column is to store the ExecutionContext value getting from the payload

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: Message of error occurred during bulk import process
